summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on technical discussions regarding the development of a data platform. Initial concerns were raised about the naming convention for the environment (suggesting `mage.allunite.local` over `etl.allunite.local`). Later, discussion covered accessing and improving the functionality of the staging environment at `https://mage.allunite.local/`, including implementing file storage and addressing session management issues like repeated authorization prompts.

Additionally, a third-party tool (`data-drift`) was reviewed for monitoring data changes. It was determined that this tool only checks if historical data has changed, not what specific large changes occurred.
decisions: The preferred local development URL is `mage.allunite.local`.
action_items: Implement file storage functionality for the staging environment at `https://mage.allunite.local/`.
Investigate improving session management to reduce repeated authorization prompts.
